archetypes.name: dyn-review-core-order
archetypes.rationale: Review core now batches branch-specific KEY=value rows and duplicate classification rows.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on python/review_pipeline.py and python/test_review_pipeline.py. Verify each ReviewCoreResult branch preserves the old stdout order, especially dispatch scout prefix rows, zero-findings classification placement, pre-voter tally failure, proposer-map failures, and duplicate trailing classification rows. Check that side effects still happen before the result is returned. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-postplan-purity
archetypes.rationale: Postplan now separates decision metadata from executor filesystem and print behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on python/design_lifecycle.py and its postplan tests. Verify _postplan_decide remains side-effect free and returns absolute tmpdir-scoped paths. Check rc 0, 10, 11, 12, 13, and fatal stdout assembly and pause behavior against the previous shell-visible contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-ship-state
archetypes.rationale: Ship rebase and postmerge helpers must preserve durable state ordering in the inline merge loop.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on python/ship.py and python/test_ship.py. Verify _ship_rebase_phase handles goto_rebase and main_advanced without moving iteration ownership, preserves stall and conflict handoff state, and leaves phase14 distinct. Check _ship_postmerge_phase is called only after caller-owned postmerge state writes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
